content: Uploads must NOT live in public/ (Next.js serves statically, same-origin → stored XSS). Options: (1) object storage S3/R2 (presigned URLs, out of scope for this project — no cloud target), (2) private dir outside public/ + authenticated route handler serving with validated Content-Type, Content-Disposition: attachment (force download, prevents inline HTML/SVG render), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; store validated MIME not user-supplied; regenerate filenames server-side. SVG is XML with script — XSS vector when served inline same-origin; reject SVG or sanitize (DOMPurify SVG profile) + serve as attachment. Upload endpoint is public — auth+role check inside handler/action. Size cap at proxy/app layer; re-encode raster images to strip EXIF/polyglot tails when feasible.
